notes:

Round-2 FINAL read-only review of b205724d..ac0a1be3ce02df805c6cfc53856b7380b1d0e7ae (two commits), rules-clause-complete profile. Reviewed the complete scoped diff and log; PR #665 / eshyra-olc5.12 base excluded. Read all requested live beads and faithful-or-absent memory, AGENTS.md, review policy, importer protocol, ADRs 0020/0017 and compiler guidance. refs/beads/state resolves to 9e4bb40c (2026-09-09), is stale, and was reconciled against live bd; its historical epic framing was not treated as current authority.

Round-1 disposition: re-ran S1 negative-dice base-pack admission/execution and table-only add-on -7 probes through the real item_state_event tool. Negative-floor dice now fail base-pack admission; negative dice outcomes and negative/fractional/nonfinite/unsafe numeric or integer-string outcomes refuse before writes. Whole-database snapshots remain unchanged with 36 charges. S1's persisted-resource-increase defect is fixed. Re-ran S2 independently validated base/add-on duplicate-row probes in both orders, unrelated duplicate keys, empty/non-string keys, missing key/amount columns, and unmatched rows: every case refuses atomically, with the complete DB unchanged. S2's reported row-key examples are fixed. Adversarial sibling review found the two residual contract defects below; the repaired mechanisms cannot yet be considered fully closed.

S3 [P2 should-fix] Require uniquely resolved deduction columns, not first matching headers. packages/core/src/state/itemResetExecutor.ts:483-485; packages/core/src/rules/validate.ts:352-354. Authority: olc5.13's explicit binding to keyColumn/amountColumn and fail-closed ambiguous-context acceptance, olc5.13.1 design steps 1-4, and ADR 0020 deterministic accounting. Both admission and execution use columns.indexOf and check only existence. The generic table schema permits repeated headers, so this remains reachable through independently validateRulesPack-accepted packs, including a table-only add-on overriding the real Cube table. Stdin probe: columns ["Spell or Item","Charges Lost","Charges Lost"], row ["Disintegrate","1","12"]; bind validated base/add-on and call real item_state_event on a face-1 Cube with 36 charges. It returns ok:true, deducts 1 and persists 35. Swap the two amount cells and it returns ok:true, deducts 12 and persists 24. Both tables also pass validation when replacing the table inside the base pack itself. Key-column sibling: columns ["Spell or Item","Spell or Item","Charges Lost"], row ["Disintegrate","Other","3"] succeeds and persists 33; swapping the key cells instead refuses the identical named event. Thus a declared column name can denote multiple conflicting cells, and the event silently selects one interpretation. This is an execution ambiguity, not merely the optional eager-admission work described by w750. Owner: deduction table admission/resolved execution boundary. Repair: require exactly one occurrence of each referenced column on the actual effective table before selecting rows, rolling, or writing, and align local deduction-table admission. Permanent evidence: generalized uniquely-bound-column invariant, parameterized over duplicate key/amount headers and column ordering on independently validated base/add-on packs, asserting whole-DB equality on refusal and retaining a uniquely named-column control. A small extension of the existing table-contract tests is proportionate. Material repair; repair and review required before approval.

S4 [P2 should-fix] Complete admission's safe-integer dice domain check. packages/core/src/rules/validate.ts:385-396. Authority: olc5.13.3 S1 explicitly requires aligning amount admission with the finite non-negative safe-integer execution domain; olc5.13.1 requires invalid deduction amounts to fail pack load. The new dice check rejects only a negative minimum; it never checks the safe-integer ceiling. Stdin probe: clone the bundled base, change only Disintegrate's amount to "1d2+9007199254740991", and validateRulesPack succeeds. Every mathematical outcome is above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, and the real item_state_event tool refuses the row rather than applying its declared deduction (four seeded probes, 36 charges retained). Keep/drop siblings "2d20kh1+9007199254740991" and "4d6dl1+9007199254740991" are likewise admitted and always refused. Equivalent unsafe numeric/integer-string amounts are correctly rejected at admission. A range straddling the ceiling is also admitted. Execution's safe-integer guard is sound and prevents corruption; the remaining consequence is admitting an unusable or outcome-dependent deduction row contrary to the required admission contract. Owner: deduction amount validator, without changing unrelated dice semantics. Repair: validate the complete possible deduction range (including keep/drop and modifier) inside the supported safe-integer domain. Permanent evidence: generalized admission-domain boundary cases covering ordinary and keep/drop dice at/beyond the upper boundary, plus valid boundary controls. This is a small extension of the existing domain tests, not a new audit framework. Material validation repair; repair and review required before approval.

Other whole-delta evidence: independently read vendored SRD p.215. The Cube predicate, five row keys/dice, columns, duration, and running-out text agree with the pack. The only records.json change adds the explicit contact economyDeduction. Inventory classifier and both regenerated artifacts describe the four new identifier fields and do not promote shared hooks or whole-item readiness. Exact effective readiness comparison using declaredItemOperationIds, deriveItemOperationReadinessInput and assertMagicItemOperationReady remains 13 ready before/after over 446 effective item/variant/operation combinations, zero changed outcomes.

Stdin conformance exercised all 75 Cube face/row/remaining combinations (five faces, five source rows, balances 0/1/36): exact seeded amounts, clamping, unchanged timers, no writes to other tables, and the separately sent exhaustion event passed. Complete self-loop census: five Cube condition loops and Immovable Rod DC30, plus five Cube via/press-face loops and Glamoured Studded Leather via/set-appearance. All six condition loops preserved their timer and an added unstarted state-entered cooldown anchor; via/use_item loops remain outside this changed path. Eleven full-DB refusal probes passed, covering missing/unknown/case-mismatched rows, absent RNG, unknown/ambiguous condition, mixed executable/opaque effects in both orders on state-changing transitions, undeclared effects, multiple deductions, and unexpected tableRow. Exhausted plus a separately sent printed runs-out event remains the explicitly authorized DM residual.

Eager stack-time rejection of otherwise execution-refused table-only add-ons (w750): no requirement beyond the operative execution fail-closed boundary; this is not a basis to defer S3 or S4.

Validation: 589 tests passed across nine focused files (itemResetExecutor, tools, semiStructuredBoundaryInventory, srdGeneratedPack, itemState, campaignRulesEndToEnd, magicItemMechanicsSchema, importer magicItemComplexStateMachines, diceGrammar). npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack passed with zero manifest/record differences and exact agreement for all generated companion artifacts. These green tests do not cover S3/S4. Git HEAD remains ac0a1be3 and the source/index/untracked status remains clean. No edits, commits, pushes, PR comments, merge, beads:sync, or changes to eshyra-olc5.13/eshyra-olc5 performed.
VERDICT: BLOCKING
